主要内容: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), America's largest automotive retailer, reported retail new vehicle unit sales of 29,046 in September 2015, a 21% increase compared to September 2014. Sales by operating segments included 9,306 Domestic units (up 27%), 13,593 Import units (up 17%), and 6,147 Premium Luxury units (up 20%). On a same-store basis, sales increased 18%. Third quarter 2015 sales totaled 89,953 units, a 7% increase from the third quarter of 2014. The company expects to report October 2015 sales on November 4, 2015. Sales data is based on manufacturer reporting standards, which may differ from GAAP requirements. The information is unaudited and excludes units acquired from Valley Motors Auto Group in September 2015, which will be included in future reports starting with October 2015 data.
